note: Lift access per trail, curated by hand. type: none | gondola | chairlift | mixed | unknown. dependency: required when the itinerary itself rides the lift, optional when a lift only shortens the walk, none otherwise. An open chairlift a route depends on is a hard stop for every dog except one declared safe on chairlifts and 8 kg or under; see scoring/recommendation-v1.js.

liftAccess.name: 5 Torri chairlift
liftAccess.notes: The itinerary rides the 5 Torri chairlift from Bai de Dones to Rifugio Scoiattoli. Dogs ride free but leashed and muzzled on the operator's rules; the chairs are open.

liftAccess.name: Alpe di Siusi cable car
liftAccess.notes: A closed cabin from Siusi to Compatsch spares the road; the loop itself needs no lift.

liftAccess.name: Télécabine du Mont d'Arbois
liftAccess.notes: A closed cabin can lift you to the top station in summer; the route also climbs on foot.

liftAccess.name: Puflatsch–Bullaccia Telemix
liftAccess.notes: The loop starts and ends in Compatsch and climbs to Puflatsch on foot; the official itinerary offers the Telemix (closed 8-seat cabins alternating with 6-seat bubble chairs) only to spare the first ascent, and the route passes its top station. Compatsch itself is reached by the closed Alpe di Siusi gondola or by bus; the road is private.

liftAccess.name: Cherz I chairlift
liftAccess.notes: The loop stays on the Cherz plateau at about 2,100 m and rides no lift. Reach it on foot from Passo Campolongo, a path from beside the Cherz I bottom station climbs about 220 m, or by the Cherz I chairlift (4-seat, open chairs) when it operates; the Vizza chairlift (2-seat, open) tops out 90 m from the start. The start point is named after a lift station as an access landmark, not because the route depends on it.
